zh: 这个月的水电费好像比平时高一些。
old_en: The utility bill for this month seems higher than usual.
new_en: The utility bill for this month seems a bit higher than usual.

zh: 我发现这个月的水电费比上个月多了。
old_en: This month's utility bill is higher than last month's.
new_en: I noticed that the utility bill this month is more than last month's.

zh: 请问这个月的账单什么时候到期？
old_en: Could you tell me when this month's bill is due?
new_en: When is the due date for this month's bill?

zh: 我想知道水电费的账单什么时候截止。
old_en: I want to know when the deadline is for this month's utility bill.
new_en: I want to know when the deadline is for the utility bill.

zh: 我已经把上个月的水电费交了。
old_en: I have already paid last month's utility bill.
new_en: I have already paid last month's utility bill.

zh: 我刚刚把这个月的水电费付掉了。
old_en: I just paid this month's utility bill.
new_en: I just paid off this month's utility bill.

zh: 我想申请开通燃气服务。
old_en: I want to apply for gas service.
new_en: I would like to apply for gas service.

zh: 请帮我开通网络服务，谢谢。
old_en: Can you help me set up internet service, please?
new_en: Please help me set up internet service, thank you.

zh: 家里突然停电，我赶紧报修。
old_en: When the power went out at home, I reported the issue right away.
new_en: The power went out at home suddenly, so I reported it right away.

zh: 今天家里停电，我打电话报修。
old_en: Today the power cut off at home, so I called to report it.
new_en: The power went out at home today, so I called to report it.

zh: 请问师傅什么时候来我家维修？
old_en: When will the technician come to fix my house?
new_en: When will the technician come to my home for repairs?

zh: 师傅您什么时候能来我家看看？
old_en: When can you come to look at my house, please?
new_en: When can you come to check my house?

zh: 我想知道房屋保险都保什么。
old_en: I want to know what a home insurance policy covers.
new_en: I want to know what home insurance covers.

zh: 我的房屋保险每年自动续费。
old_en: My home insurance renews automatically every year.
new_en: My home insurance renews automatically every year.

zh: 事故发生后，我详细说明了情况。
old_en: After the accident, I gave a detailed account of what happened.
new_en: After the accident, I explained the situation in detail.

zh: 我告诉保险公司事故经过和损失。
old_en: I informed the insurance company about the accident and the damages.
new_en: I told the insurance company about the accident and the damage.

zh: 我需要知道理赔要哪些文件。
old_en: I need to know what documents are required for a claim.
new_en: I need to know what documents are required for the claim.

zh: 我把理赔需要的材料都准备好了。
old_en: I have gathered all the materials needed for the claim.
new_en: I have prepared all the materials needed for the claim.

zh: 保险报销的钱还没到我的账户。
old_en: The insurance reimbursement hasn't arrived in my account yet.
new_en: The insurance reimbursement money hasn't reached my account yet.

zh: 还没收到保险报销的钱。
old_en: I haven't received the insurance reimbursement money yet.
new_en: I haven't received the insurance reimbursement yet.
